title: Engineer Reveals Humans Piloted Nvidia's Microduck AI Demo
summary:
Four technicians manually operated the robotic ducks during Jensen Huang's showcase at GTC Berlin, contradicting the presentation's framing of the devices as autonomous AI agents. An engineer who worked as a positioner below the stage publicly confirmed that the robots were human-piloted while they performed actions such as sitting, napping and doing somersaults, challenging the claim that Nvidia is moving AI agents from virtual worlds to the real world.

The Microduck was engineered in Bordeaux, France, by Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face using American capital and Chinese manufacturing. The device is the most popular robot of 2026, with more than 15,000 units sold globally. The demonstration served as the final stop on the Nvidia CEO's promotional tour of Europe.
